decisions.statement: Every folder under `cluster` matches a folder shape.
A service's own manifest sits with that service rather than under `cluster`.
A module one service alone reaches sits under that service's `modules` folder.
A module more than one service reaches sits under the domain with those services.
A workload names the class of node the workload runs on.
A workload reaches a node by the needs that workload states rather than by a class node carries.
The machines people use day to day run Linux and are nodes in the cluster.
The work a person did on a cluster machine under Windows is work that person can still do.
Work stops on a machine the moment a person starts using that machine.

definition: the Kubernetes cluster the system's services run on
